answer: Each identity binds one passport: its hash enters the mesa registry on a 35 POA bond locked 90 days. A second use forfeits both bonds. Each extra passport in one cluster doubles the bond (35/70/140, capped 1,120 POA from the sixth). Brokered ones cost 90 POA, doubling every 50 sold. 100 fakes lock 107,485 POA plus 13,500 POA fees, vs 3,500 POA honest. Border control re-attests each passport in the island ledger within 72 hours each epoch. Two misses halve the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. The ocean index lists issuers. Without a passport, a national ID card works with a doubled bond.
